high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "beautifuldestinations," which is located in Copenhagen, Denmark. The post features an aerial view of a modern architectural complex with a distinctive design. The buildings are circular and interconnected, featuring large glass windows and green roofs covered with solar panels. The surrounding area includes well-maintained pathways, green spaces, and some trees, indicating a blend of urban development and nature. The post has garnered significant engagement, with 290,375 likes and 1,094 comments.
